limitations: Candidate c16: public 1a2d8e72 (the c15 tree 64c3e71 squashed for publication, candidateDigest ca071c95) + three CI fixes and nothing else: .github/workflows/release.yml installs the packages before the readiness checks, packages/run-spaceapp/tests/runtime.test.mjs reads compose.yml with LF line endings on Windows checkouts, and PUBLIC_EXPORT_MANIFEST.json records the size and SHA-256 of the package-lock.json this tree carries. No launcher, image or app code changed, so every check and supplementary proof stays c15's (c14's own run, or what c14 carried from c13) with its createdAt.

Candidate c15: public lab tree 64c3e71 (stamp 1.2.0) = c14 1e365cf + the 1.2.0 Zen first-answer exception and the 1.2.0 stamp, nothing else. Every check and supplementary proof is c14's own run (or what c14 carried from c13) and names c14 in carriedFrom with the c14..c15 diff stat. The tested launcher and images carry the lab stamp 1.2.0-nous.c14 (testedArtifacts); the release workflow rebuilds the images from this source, and the published package must pass scripts/shipped-image-evidence.mjs before latest.

Candidate c14: public lab tree 1e365cf (lab stamp 1.2.0-nous.c14, not a release version) = c13 cf4d247 + the export of Space dev 6f572c31d2, which holds 31944be0df (a busy CLI credential agent is asked again for up to 20 s instead of read as signed out) and 06146070da (self-hosted skips the gateway-priority-panes push).

c14's own runs on 1e365cf: fresh install, the real 1.1.9 -> 1.2.0-nous.c14 update and the first agent (Codex) on Linux vm218, Windows vm219 and macOS vm221, and telemetry No on Linux. Repair, Docker stopped and the medium and large profile transitions are carried from c13 cf4d247, each marked carriedFrom with its reason.

The small profile was not run as a transition of its own: every c14 fresh install selected small (7.7-8 GiB runners) and reached ready on it, and every c13 transition started from small (small -> medium, small -> large) with data preserved.

Known environment/provider limit, not a SpaceApp defect, one failed check per system (first-agent, the free-model first answer): from the lab's egress address OpenCode Zen answered "Free usage limit reached" (provider.quota) for big-pickle, deepseek-v4.1-flash-free, glm-5.3-flash-free and iceman-free and "not available in your country" (provider.auth) for inkling-2-small-free, on all three systems (records 2026-11-09T23:45:14.586Z, 2026-11-10T00:32:03.979Z, 2026-11-10T01:24:39.821Z). Decision nous-20261106-report-25457 (Nous 6/11, as 1.1.9's ZEN_KNOWN): 1.2.0 has no zenFirstAnswerExceptions entry, so scripts/release-evidence.mjs names these three checks. The Codex first agent through Space Gateway (spacegw/gpt-5-mini, not a free model) passed on all three systems as a supplementary proof.

After 'spaceapp credentials set codex' the runtime list showed Codex LOGIN_REQUIRED for 559-606 s (the 10-minute missing-credential cache); the lab waited it out. The fix ships on dev only and is not part of 1.2.0-nous.c14.

Not re-run on c13 or c14: rc3 (c13 vm218 and vm221 failed only on oneSharedServer, as c12 on all three), update badge and two native panes on Windows (c13 vm219 stopped on an upstream OpenCode catalog 503), Getting Started first prompt, telemetry Yes, upgrade from 1.1.7, automatic browser opening.
